name: What is the typical cost range for a single room renovation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a single room renovation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a single room renovation in the Bay Area varies significantly based on room type, size, and material choices. For instance, a basic bathroom renovation might start from $15,000, while a kitchen could begin at $30,000 due to appliances and intricate plumbing/electrical work. Factors like custom cabinetry, high-end fixtures, or structural changes can increase costs substantially. A detailed estimate requires an on-site consultation to assess your specific needs and the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a single room renovation in the Bay Area typically range from $15,000 for a basic bathroom to over $30,000 for a kitchen, depending on materials and scope.
